excludedMutationAttempts.reason: Removing the pointer call left its import unused; no original callback ran. A subsequent compiling mutation retained the pointer call and changed its returned line.

The earlier original assertion checked the overall incomplete result. The evidence parser independently rejected the stale rendered bytes, so that assertion did not isolate collector rejection. The original callback was strengthened to require collector exit 2 and no packet before repeating this guard.

developmentObservations: Native Kustomize origin annotations identify resource files, not overlay field override positions. Supported override addresses are separately recorded from original physical source nodes, and native output must exactly reconcile with the bounded model before findings are emitted.
An invalid base replica value can be replaced by a valid overlay. Removing that override exposes the original base schema defect.

A first collector control had an off-by-one source-line expectation. Independently numbered original source confirmed the physical value line; the expectation was corrected without changing production addressing.

A compiling collector guard mutation survived the earlier overall-incomplete assertion because the independent parser still rejected the changed bytes. The original control now also requires collector rejection before packet emission.
Nonfinite YAML values are rejected before JSON cloning can collapse them to null.
